notes: Cross-repo consistency artifact only, per Cenit Digital's TemplateSSDUncleBob convention (docs/configuration.md in that template). This file is NOT wired to bin/harness or .harness/harness.mjs: this adoption deliberately does not introduce that engine into this repository. The real, CI-enforced verification chain is scripts/validate-iac.sh plus scripts/lint.sh (see .github/workflows/validate.yml). Full rationale and the mapping to this repo's own agents and gates: docs/adopcion-templatessd.md.

commands_notes.mutate: Deliberately empty: no mutation-testing tool fits this stack (unittest only, Python 3.14 required, several tests are purely static). See mutation.not_applicable_reason below and .claude/agents/guardrail-adversary.md.
commands_notes.build: Deliberately empty: there is no single production build step. The closest analogue -- rendering Jinja templates into their Ansible-managed output -- already runs as part of commands.test, via validate-iac.sh's render-platform-assets/render-edge playbooks.

paths_notes: No paths.src, paths.features, paths.spec, or paths.feature_list: this repo has no single src/ directory (ansible/, infra/terraform/, stacks/, scripts/, and config/ are all production code), no Gherkin contract layer, and no feature_list.json. Its spec is CLAUDE.md plus docs/*.md plus the config/*.yml contracts; its 'progress' is CHANGELOG.md plus the Open STOP gates section of CLAUDE.md. See docs/adopcion-templatessd.md.

mutation.not_applicable_reason: Verified by grep: zero occurrences of pytest, mutmut, or cosmic-ray in this repository. The suite is unittest, some of it purely static (parses rendered YAML/templates and asserts on structure; mutating production Python would move none of those assertions and would produce a misleading score). Adopted substitute: .claude/agents/guardrail-adversary.md's per-gate negative-test discipline, reported as PASS or SUPERVIVIENTES(N), not a numeric mutation score. See CHECKPOINTS.md C7 and docs/adopcion-templatessd.md.

rules_notes: Key names were deliberately renamed from the template's one_feature_at_a_time / require_approved_spec_to_implement / require_mutation_to_close: reusing those exact names with a different real-world meaning underneath would be less honest than naming what this repo actually enforces. See docs/adopcion-templatessd.md.
